items.name: Slack-style channel
items.description: A workspace channel in the light purple theme. Sidebar with channels and DMs, #launch header with member avatars, an app deploy message, launch messages landing with reaction pills that pop and count up, a 12-reply thread row and typing under the composer.

items.name: WhatsApp-style group chat
items.description: A desktop group chat: chat list with filter chips, doodle wallpaper, white and green bubbles with tails and coloured sender names, one reaction pill per bubble that widens as emoji join, a quoted reply, blue ticks and 'is typing…' in the header.

items.name: X-style reply thread
items.description: A dark-mode post page with views, replies, reposts and likes ticking up and the like turning pink. New replies land under 'Post your reply', beside a right column with a profile card and trends.

items.name: YouTube-style live chat
items.description: A dark live-stream page with vintage rocket-launch footage in the player and a LIVE bar. Watching and like counts tick while the live chat scrolls with owner, moderator and member names, a Super Chat card and its ticker, and reactions floating up.
